datasets.name: Bijie landslide data set
datasets.verbatim: The freely available Bijie landslide data set (Ji et al. 2020) is used for experimentation.

methods.name: U-Net with backbone models (ResNet-50, ResNet-101, VGG-19, and DenseNet-121)
methods.summary: The authors propose an enhanced U-Net model for landslide detection, utilizing four different pre-trained backbone models (ResNet-50, ResNet-101, VGG-19, and DenseNet-121) for feature extraction to improve detection accuracy.

reproducibility_assessment: The Bijie landslide dataset is referenced but not linked, and the custom U-Net model code is not provided or linked.
